For purposes hereunder,“community parks and recreation” shall mean public parks and
recreational public works, including facilitating activities for the greater Cheyenne community
such as sports, exercise, recreation services, classes, arts and crafts, cultural activities, music,
drama and other social and community activities, and including but not limited to the planning
and/or construction of indoor and outdoor recreational facilities, youth and senior citizen
communities and facilities, city parks and playgrounds, and offices and support facilities related
to the foregoing, all with the intent to improve andmaintain the quality of life of thegreater
land set aside for public use, maintained for the enjoyment and recreational use of people.
"Recreation" shall mean the act of participating in experiences that result in achieving and
maintaining the balance required formembers of the public to live lifefully and to realize their
full potential.
